description: This file contains the class definition for S3EncryptionClientV2 in the Aws\S3\Crypto namespace. It provides a client wrapper for encrypting and decrypting objects stored in Amazon S3, utilizing PHP streams and promises for asynchronous operations. The class supports enhanced data security practices, integrates with AWS KMS, and relies on multiple traits for functionality. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for client-side encryption with S3.

classes.name: S3EncryptionClientV2
classes.description: A wrapper client for Amazon S3 that provides server-side encryption and decryption of objects, supporting asynchronous operations, metadata management, and integration with AWS KMS. It uses traits to assemble encryption, decryption, and user-agent functionalities and handles the complexity of client-side encryption workflows.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the S3EncryptionClientV2 with an existing S3Client, optional instruction file suffix, and setups metrics middleware.

methods.name: putObjectAsync
methods.description: Encrypts the object data and uploads it asynchronously to S3, returning a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: putObject
methods.description: Encrypts and uploads the object synchronously by waiting on the putObjectAsync promise.

methods.name: getObjectAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an object from S3, decrypts its data asynchronously, and returns a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts an object synchronously by waiting on the getObjectAsync promise.
